sourceRule: Root nav role=navigation is named pagination; Content/Item are ul/li. PaginationLink renders Button as anchor with nativeButton=false; isActive sets aria-current=page and outline instead of ghost, size defaults icon. Previous/Next default text and accessible English labels can be overridden for localization. Ellipsis is aria-hidden. The wrapper does not calculate page count, clamp indices, fetch results or implement a disabled prop on PaginationLink.
keyboardAndFocus: Real links retain Tab/Enter and normal modified click navigation. There is no roving arrow selection. This reference omits unavailable Previous/Next links at boundaries instead of attaching a fake disabled attribute to an anchor. A router may prevent default onClick and navigate itself; the component does not commit a page index before the caller updates isActive.

protocol: SCXML consumes actual source/native transaction observations; callback objects remain original. Sends document observed callbacks, not second DOM dispatches. Parent-controlled props alone synchronize authoritative values. HTML/CSS is a semantic projection; executable behavior uses actual pinned React wrappers.
